items.item_text: Background Check and Live Scan
Employment Misconduct
Legal Right to Work in the United States
Vaccination Policies
Smoking and Tobacco Policy
Drug Free Environment
California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act
E-Verify
Pre-Placement Health Evaluation
UC Anti-Discrimination Policy
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple teams within a large healthcare enterprise.
Strong preference for experience using any one of the cloud-based technologies such as MS Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, and GCP.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Experience working in an academic hospital in the role of Enterprise Data Architect or an equivalent position.
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation within a centralized code repository and database modeling tools
Experience in understanding the healthcare privacy and regulatory laws not limiting to HIPAA, HITECH, PCI etc.,
8+ years of experience in architecting, developing, deploying, and supporting complex data and analytics applications in medium to large-scale healthcare data warehouse environments.
Ability to work effectively in an agile team structure, with hands-on experience using agile tools such as Confluence, JIRA, and MS Teams.
5+ years of hands-on experience with ETL tools like Matillion, DBT, Talend, Informatica, and MS Factory.

Strong track record of successfully leading technical data strategy, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of modern cloud enterprise data warehouse platforms to support analytics including data science and AI on one of the cloud platforms like MS Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Expertise in mapping data from systems such as Strata, API, Kronos, Oracle ERP, Kuali Finance system, and EMRs like Epic, Cerner, and Athena, as well as integrating data from other third-party vendor applications and handling large file transfers across internal and external systems.
Must be willing and able to work occasional weekends and evenings as needed
Must possess the skills, knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Broad knowledge of business processes, including financial, clinical, and operational requirements of health systems.
